Title: AMD 2026Q2 Preview (Historical Reconstruction)

This preview is a historical reconstruction. It uses only information published on or before 2026-05-05. It does not include information from the 2026Q2 earnings release.

Last-quarter baseline:
AMD reported Q1 2026 revenue of $10.3 billion. GAAP gross margin was 53%. Non-GAAP gross margin was 55%. Data Center segment revenue was $5.8 billion, up 57% year over year. Data Center was the primary driver of revenue and earnings growth. Client revenue was $2.9 billion, up 26%. Gaming revenue was $720 million, up 11%. Embedded revenue was $873 million, up 6%.

Company guidance for Q2 2026:
AMD guided revenue of approximately $11.2 billion, plus or minus $300 million. The midpoint represents year-over-year growth of about 46% and sequential growth of about 9%. AMD guided non-GAAP gross margin of approximately 56%.

Core questions:
1. Will Data Center growth accelerate in Q2?
2. Will MI450 and Helios engagements convert to revenue in Q2?
3. Will non-GAAP gross margin reach the guided 56%?

Potential positive deviations:
Strong AI infrastructure demand. Meta plans to deploy up to 6 GW of AMD Instinct GPUs, with the first 1 GW using an MI450-based GPU. MI355X showed leading MLPerf results. Cloud providers expanded 5th Gen EPYC instances.

Potential negative deviations:
Supply constraints for HBM, memory, packaging, and manufacturing. Competition. Export controls and tariffs. Weak semi-custom revenue may continue to pressure Gaming.

Verification points in the next earnings release:
Revenue within $11.2B plus or minus $300M. Data Center segment growth. Non-GAAP gross margin near 56%. Management comments on MI450, Helios, and supply.

Analysis:
There was no contemporaneous preview written before the 2026Q2 earnings date. This document is a historical reconstruction. It does not add post-earnings results.
reader_questions: 公司指引称 2026Q2 收入中点同比约 +46%，但新闻稿未披露 2025Q2 实际收入绝对额，外部读者无法验证基数。若去年同期基数异常低，46% 的同比增速可能高估增长势头，是否应在正文中提示这一限制？
non-GAAP 毛利率从 Q4'25 的 57% 降至 Q1'26 的 55%，公司指引 56% 仍未回到前高。本稿将其列为正负预期差项，是否应同时说明这是环比修复而非持续回升？
Meta 6GW 部署计划未披露时间表和 Q2 内可确认收入；MI450 系列量产状态和订单能见度也未说明。若不区分“合作公告”与“已确认订单”，读者可能高估 Q2 收入影响，正文应如何明确这一限制？
